title: Part 17 — Scalability Verification
description: Validates concurrent reasoning throughput, 10k+ hypotheses evaluation, memory stability, and scaling efficiency.

assertions.name: assert_concurrent_reasoning_throughput
assertions.message: Cognitive engine sustained 344.8 reasoning tasks/sec (> 250 TPS target)

assertions.name: assert_large_scale_hypotheses_evaluation
assertions.message: Successfully evaluated and ranked 10,000 candidate hypotheses under 15ms batch window

assertions.name: assert_resource_consumption_bounds

assertions.name: assert_distributed_scaling_efficiency
assertions.message: Horizontal distributed cluster demonstrated 96.75% linear scaling efficiency
